note: [L] makes the probe zero through `ranging`/`payment`, which proves nondegeneracy of the covariance by a radial flux identity (`radial_flux`) for the wave polynomial, not by the explicit Kelvin formula eq:G-kelvin.

snippet.text:
have ht : i=∑ c, flavor j c (flavor_pick i c) := by
      ext u; rw [LinearMap.sum_apply]; conv_lhs => rw [← half_sum u, map_sum]
      rfl
    have hm (c) : flavor_pick i c=0 := by
      apply ranging c _ k; intro z hz q
      have H (z) (h : z∈away) : pairing (l:=j) h (flavor k c q) i=0 :=
        (Submodule.mem_dualCoannihilator _).mp hi _ (show _∈ W from Submodule.subset_span ⟨z,h,c,q,rfl⟩)
      have he : K i (flavor k c q) z 0=0 := (K_symmetric _ _ hz).trans (H _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hz.symm))
      rw [ht,K_pairing _ _ hz,map_sum,LinearMap.sum_apply,Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem c (Finset.mem_univ _)] at he
      · change fare c (flavor_pick i c) q (z-0)=_ at he
        rwa [sub_zero] at he

proof_context.conclusion: `flavor_pick i c = 0` follows from `ranging` applied to `K i (flavor k c q)` vanishing, so the probe `i` is zero.

snippet.text: lemma payment {p : Flavor j} (h : ∀ (z : E4),z≠0 → ∀ q : Flavor 0, fare c p q z=0) : p=0 := by

proof_context.conclusion: A flavor `p` whose `fare c p q z` against every order-zero `q` vanishes at all `z != 0` is zero, by nondegeneracy of the order-zero covariance.
